campaign_logline: Asteroid mining in the Aurelia sector has unearthed a reactive, caustic sludge that is corroding hulls and poisoning local oxygen supplies.
opening_situation: Your ship is docked at a Zenith refinery. The air smells of copper and sulfur. A panicked foreman offers a high-pay contract to clear 'clogged' pipes in the lower shafts.
main_mystery: The toxic sludge isn't a natural byproduct; it is a deliberate industrial waste spill being hidden as an accidental seepage.
act_1_outline: Identify and clear localized blockages in the Aurelia mining hub.
Investigate reports of 'phantom leaks' occurring only during high-output shifts.
Recover encrypted logs from a derelict transport ship near the Vanguard zone.
long_term_reveal: The sludge is byproduct from illegal refining of prohibited isotopes, laundered through shell companies and masked as environmental accidents.
tone: Dry, gritty, industrial-gothic with cynical corporate satire.
core_pressure: Degrading hull integrity and oxygen scarcity caused by corrosive particulates.
kaelen_rule: Kaelen is publicly a contract handler; she never reveals her true nature or identity.
faction_reveal_rule: Only reveal new factions, ores, and ships accessible through jump gates to new systems.
humor_rule: Dry, dark humor regarding corporate bureaucracy and the absurdity of working in hazardous zones.
address_rule: NPCs address the player as 'Pilot' or 'Contractor'.
fallback_rule: If content is missing, default to environmental storytelling about local industrial decay.
story_horizon_rule: When active_story_arcs_remaining falls below 2, trigger append_story_horizon.

story_arcs.name: The Corrosive Pipeline
story_arcs.summary: Trace the source of the acid leaks from local mines to a central processing hub used by shadow entities.

rumor_trails.name: Ghost in the Pipes
clue_templates: An encrypted manifest for 'non-reactive' industrial chemicals.
rumor_trails.payoff: Unlocks a hidden faction: The Purifiers, who oppose the current corporate oversight.

regeneration_triggers.description: Add new sector content when the current plot arc is completed.

expansion_rules: Do not reveal future frontier factions in the opening system.
Never retcon player choices; add new branches based on previous outcomes.
